products.name: Apex Titan-9 Gaming Rig
products.desc: The absolute pinnacle of gaming performance. Armed with a liquid-cooled AMD Ryzen 9 processor and the powerhouse NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080, the Titan-9 crushes high-refresh-rate 4K gaming and streaming workloads alike. Housed in our signature glass panoramic chassis.

products.name: Apex Nebula-7 Pro
products.desc: Compact footprint, massive performance. The Nebula-7 Pro is an ITX masterpiece featuring an optimized airflow chassis, GeForce RTX 4070, and Ryzen 7. Perfect for small spaces without compromising an inch of frames or thermal performance.

products.name: Vengeance RGB 32GB DDR5 Memory
products.desc: Optimize your system memory with ultra-fast Vengeance DDR5. Operating at a blistering 6000MHz, this dual-channel 32GB kit features dynamic ten-zone RGB lighting and hand-screened ICs for advanced overclocking reliability.

products.name: Dominator Extreme 64GB DDR5 Memory
products.desc: The ultimate DDR5 memory kit for creators and extreme enthusiasts. Dominator Platinum RGB features premium craftsmanship, forged aluminum heatspreaders with patented DHX cooling, and 6400MHz clock speeds.

products.name: Odyssey G7 27" Curved Monitor
products.desc: Unmatched immersion. Featuring a deep 1000R curvature matching the human eye, a lightning-fast 240Hz refresh rate, QHD resolution, and 1ms response time, the Odyssey G7 is the perfect competitive display.

products.name: Predator X34 Ultra-Wide Monitor
products.desc: Expand your field of view. The Predator 34" Ultrawide offers panoramic curved gaming with an IPS panel for stunning color accuracy, 144Hz refresh rate, and NVIDIA G-Sync Ultimate for tear-free gameplay.

products.name: Apex Titan Glass Mid-Tower
products.desc: A designer's dream. Showcase your setup with three premium tinted tempered glass panels. Features an dual-chamber layout for clean cable routing and comes loaded with four addressable ARGB fans pre-wired to an smart controller.

products.name: Nebula Mini-ITX Case
products.desc: A small-form-factor powerhouse with zero performance compromises. Built with mesh ventilation panels on five sides to maximize airflow, this Mini-ITX chassis supports full-sized triple-slot graphics cards and custom water cooling.

products.name: Apex Hyperion Linear Keyboard
products.desc: Bespoke typing feel right out of the box. Featuring a heavy CNC-milled aluminum top frame, hot-swappable sockets, pre-lubed linear switches, and sound-absorbing silicone gaskets for a quiet, buttery keystroke.

products.name: Apex Cobra Wireless Mouse
products.desc: Zero drag. Zero lag. Clocking in at an ultralight 59 grams, the Cobra features our proprietary 26K DPI optical sensor and 2.4GHz hyperspeed wireless tech for pixel-perfect tracking and instant 0.2ms click response.

products.name: Apex Void 7.1 Wireless Headset
products.desc: Hear everything. Featuring 50mm Hi-Res neodymium drivers and 7.1 DTS spatial sound, the Void gaming headset delivers absolute audio precision. Built with plush cooling-gel earcups and a broadcast-grade fold-away microphone.
